confirm.description: Do you want to set up independent front and back lights for your LIFX Mirror?

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration is possible.
abort.no_devices_found: No LIFX Mirror found. Add your Mirror to the LIFX integration first.

set_state.name: Set state
set_state.description: Set the state of the LIFX Mirror frontlight and backlight independently. Set brightness to 0 to turn off a light.

device_id.name: Devices
device_id.description: List of LIFX Mirror devices to target.

transition.name: Transition
transition.description: Duration in seconds to transition to the new state.

frontlight_saturation.name: Frontlight saturation
frontlight_saturation.description: Saturation in percent, where 0 is white and 100 is fully saturated.

frontlight_brightness.name: Frontlight brightness
frontlight_brightness.description: Brightness in percent, where 0 is off and 100 is maximum.

frontlight_kelvin.name: Frontlight kelvin
frontlight_kelvin.description: Color temperature in Kelvin between 1500 and 9000.

backlight_saturation.name: Backlight saturation
backlight_saturation.description: Saturation in percent, where 0 is white and 100 is fully saturated.

backlight_brightness.name: Backlight brightness
backlight_brightness.description: Brightness in percent, where 0 is off and 100 is maximum.

backlight_kelvin.name: Backlight kelvin
backlight_kelvin.description: Color temperature in Kelvin between 1500 and 9000.

set_zones.name: Set zones
set_zones.description: Set the individual zones of the frontlight or backlight, using a list of colors, a gradient or colored segments along the Mirror's length, or a named theme. Give exactly one of colors, gradient, segments or theme.

device_id.name: Devices
device_id.description: List of LIFX Mirror devices to target.

component.name: Light
component.description: Which light to set, front or back.

colors.name: Colors
colors.description: One color per zone (25 for each light), each with optional hue (0-360), saturation (%), brightness (%) and kelvin.

gradient.name: Gradient
gradient.description: Two or more colors spread evenly along the Mirror's length, from the end opposite the buttons to the end with the buttons.

theme.name: Theme
theme.description: A LIFX theme, by the name shown in the light's effect list (such as Warm Ember) or its key (such as warm_ember).

transition.name: Transition
transition.description: Duration in seconds to transition to the new state.

segments.name: Segments
segments.description: Stretches of the Mirror's length, each with a start and end in percent (0 is the end opposite the buttons, 100 the end with them) and a color. Zones outside every segment are turned dark.
